meta.rule: One row per emitted string that the witness-emitter guard is told to tolerate. A row names the substring, the file it sits in, the roadmap row that owns the fix, and why the string cannot simply be restated today. A row that matches no emitted string fails the case (TestTheEmitterLedgerStillNamesStringsThatExist), so an exemption cannot outlive its sentence. Adding a row is a decision about a string the toolchain says out loud: it is reviewed with the row that owns it, never added to make a run green.
